text: Chaathuuladroth was a green dragon inhabiting the region of Okoth in the .

The (Russian: 9К22 "Тунгуска"; NATO reporting name: SA-19 "Grison") is a Soviet Union/Russian-built self-propelled anti-aircraft vehicle developed by the in . It has been in service since 1982 and saw combat in the South Ossetia War in 2008. The weapon system was designed to counter any variety of airborne threats, including the American A-10 Warthog, and is armed with eight 9M311-1M ground-to-air missiles and twin 30mm 2A38M autocannons.

Cejor was probably a metallic dragon who was caught by the silver dragon Azhaq in the act of brewing some useless potion as part of her experiments in mitigating the Rage of Dragons. She gave up Karasendrieth's name once questioned on her experiments, which led to Lareth ordering she be caught, per Llimark's reckoning, on Hammer 6 in .
Ce'Nedra was a powerful and villainous sorceress who menaced the dwarves of Citadel Felbarr sometime before 1054 DR.
Chandri was a Selûnite priestess and the chief healer of Moonshadow Hall in Yhaunn during the 14 century DR.

The Ling-Temco-Vought A-7 Corsair II is a carrier-based subsonic light attack aircraft introduced to replace the United States Navy's Douglas A-4 Skyhawk, initially entering service during the Vietnam War. __TOC__

Chameleon power, also known simply as chameleon, was a minor psionic devotion of the psychometabolism discipline that allowed a manifester to blend in with their surroundings in a manner akin to a chameleon.
Ceryx was a human fire elementalist wandering the lands in search of the Seven Lost Rings of Mhzentul in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Cerberus was a gargantuan three-headed dog-like creature famous for guarding the entrance to the Underworld of Hades.

The Douglas A-1 Skyraider was an American single-seat attack aircraft that saw service between the late 1940s and early 1980s. It was armed with 4 20mm autocannons and could carry 8000 pounds of external __TOC__
Celestial dragonnels were a species of dragonnels, lesser dragons, that inhabited the higher realms.
Charthraxis was a green dragon that dwelled in the region of the Sword Coast North that had an association with the Cult of the Dragon in the late 15 century DR.

A chasme ( ), sometimes called a fly demon, was a type of tanar'ri demon found in the Abyss. Chasmes were horrid and disgusting hybrids of flies and humans, who sucked blood and enjoyed tormenting or torturing their victims. The droning of their wings could lull to sleep an unwary being, who might awake to find themselves being fed upon and tortured. Chasmes often served greater demons as interrogators, taskmasters, or torturers, or in capturing runaways and deserters of the Blood War.

The AMV-2 Groundhog is an Armored Personnel Carrier used by the European Union in the 22nd Century, used to deploy infantry in battle in relative safety. It is featured in Battlefield 2142. The driver operates a fast-firing LMG turret with an EMP grenade launcher that can immobilize other vehicles. The gunner remotely operates a mortar system that fires three shells with an effective range of 250 meters. All passengers can use slower-firing LMG turrets. Passengers also have access to assault pod launchers that can be used for quick escape, for boarding Titans or other high points, and as a makeshift anti-aircraft weapon. When near a Titan (or the loading platforms in Port Bavaria), the pod launch system pressurizes to full strength, with an indicator available to the driver. In all other cases, the pods only permit limited ascent. The Groundhog has an overall armor level comparable to a main battle tank, but does not take additional damage to any side of the vehicle.

A chimera ( ; ) was a large magical beast that was a combination of several different creatures, namely a dragon, a goat, and a lion. Although typically unintelligent, chimeras were self-aware creatures, with a limited capacity for language, often Draconic.

Cho Lu-k'u was a wizard who once lived in Koryo. Cho Lu-k'u died in the Dang Caverns and cursed its tunnels. This may have led to the evil monsters that lurked there. Meo Cha heard of this story from his old tutor some time before 1350 DR.
Chirasu was a Kozakuran goddess of stealth and counted as one of the Eight Million Gods. She was a patron of ninja, yakuza, and others who wished for their deeds to go unnoticed.

The UAZ-469 (УАЗ-469) is a Russian, all-terrain vehicle that was introduced in 1973. The Soviet government and military saw the UAZ-469 as an effective vehicle due to its capability to drive through virtually all terrain types and its ability to be easily repaired.
Charvekkanathor the Scarlet was a mighty red dragon who made his lair at Rrinnoroth, an abandoned dwarven outpost in the Kuldin Peaks.
Chen Ching Ch'ien was a river spirit folk kensai in Cham Fau in Shou Lung in the mid–14 century DR.
A chaos beast was a horrible and ever-changing creature of the planes. Its lethal touch could transform a victim into an amorphous mass, and ultimately a chaos beast themselves.

The 2S25 Sprut-SD (Russian: Спрут; English: Kraken) is a light tank based on the BMD-3 chassis, but with a much larger 125mm smoothbore gun. It is a modern-day tank destroyer manufactured by Volograd Tractor Factory. The 2S25 Sprut retains most of the features of its BMD-3 cousin and is meant for the Russian Airborne forces as a tank destroyer that can be airlifted into battle and move about quickly. The armor on the turret is made of welded aluminum with a composite skin to keep it light for airborne drops, but it retains the strength to be able to hold up against 23mm rounds from about 500 meters away. __TOC__
Chigatta was a reclusive artisan, weaponsmith, and master of mystic arts in Kara-Tur.

Chereth, eventually the Old Man of the Mountain, was a druid, follower of Silvanus, and Master of the Yuirwood. He resurrected the assassin Kheil and retrained him as Berun. On , he attempted to destroy all of civilization in Faerûn with a supervolcano.
Craum Straug was a senile geriatric red dragon whose bones were used in creation of the legendary musical instrument called the Pipes of the Wheezing Dragon.

Not to be confused with the Tiger tank. The , also known as the AS-665 Tiger or its company designation EC665 Tiger, is an attack helicopter built by originally for the French and German Army, but it has since been purchased for the and armies as well. The helicopter has seen service in the since 2009 under the French Army, and has seen use in the enforcing . The original HAP (French: Hélicoptère d'Appui Protection, English: Support and Escort Helicopter) version of the helicopter was introduced into service in 2003 and is armed with a 30mm chin-mounted autocannon and can carry rockets or 20mm autocannons in gun pods, as well as missiles for air-to-air combat. Other variants have mounted and rockets for ground attack, while FIM-92 Stinger missiles have been mounted for air attack. __TOC__
Crypt King was an angry undead specter that dwelt within one of the tombs of Athkatla's Grave District in the late 14 century DR.
Cureh Lantinye was a Moonsea skysentinel commander of the Knights of the North in 1374 DR. He led a patrol of sky sentinels on the caravan route between Melvaunt and Glister in Thar.
The "Dai-Oni" was a disguised tengu master of the Black Temple in Kozakura in 1357 DR.

The ACOG (Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight) is a series of magnified weapon scopes made by the American company Trijicon. Their scopes commonly offer a magnification of 4x, meaning anything viewed down the scope will be four times bigger than when viewed normally. Usually, ACOG scopes utilize luminescent materials such as Tritium or optical fibers to improve aiming and target acquisition. The ACOG series of weapon scopes is used by the US Armed Forces, as well as parts of other nations' armies such as the British Armed Forces.
Queen Cyndra was a windsoul genasi and the ruler of Akanûl in the early years of the 15 century DR.

A dark naga was a variety of naga that looked like a large purple snake or eel with a barbed stinger at the end of its tail and a human face. Dark nagas could speak Common and Infernal. They liked to plot with other sinister creatures so that they could gather wealth more easily.

Daltim Flamefist was a male Halruaan human wizard and psionicist from the realm of Halruaa in south Faerûn. He was well known as a powerful noble of Halruaa; as the commander of the Destroyers, a mercenary company of mages and psionicists; and for his groundbreaking research into fire magic, psionics, and the creation and reproduction of magical and psionic items.

The is a Soviet-made bullpup assault rifle developed by in 1990. It fires the (A-91 and A-91M) or (5.56A-91), depending on the model. There is also a special version chambered in the M74 and PSP (underwater) called the ADS. Its magazine holds 30 rounds, and it fires about 700 rounds per minute. It features an optional 40mm GP-95 grenade launcher mounted below the barrel. The A-91 also features a forward case ejection like the Belgian F2000. The A-91 appears in four games in the Battlefield series. The 5.56 variant appears in Battlefield Play4Free, , and Battlefield 2042, while a version firing 5.45x39mm appears in .
Daolani, or sand gen, were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Earth. They were also sometimes called earth gen.

The dark ones were a race of humanoids native to the Shadowfell and often found in the Underdark. They were natural rogues with powers of stealth and shadow. They were apparently divided into two species or subspecies: the short, squat dark creepers and the human-sized dark stalkers.
The dark creepers were a race of humanoids dwelling in the Underdark. They were natural rogues with powers of stealth and shadow. They were one of the two subraces of the dark ones.

An anti-tank guided missile (ATGM) launcher is a weapon system that provides its user with armor penetrating capability, through the use of a powerful TOW missile, which can be guided by the user. Certain systems are designed to be mounted on vehicles, allowing them to counter threats posed by tanks and to clear obstructions for infantry.

Darah Thorne was a bloodforge mage who laid claim to Herne's Wood in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars (648–657 DR). Although warned to avoid Herne's Wood, the leader of the Legendary Campaign was forced to camp by its edge. Darah Thorne marshaled bloodforged forces against them, insisting on being given tribute in exchange for staying there, but the leader chose to fight instead.

A darkenbeast, also called a death horror or dark horror, was an artificial magical beast created by evil spellcasters. They were transformed from ordinary animals into terrifying monsters loyal to their master's will.

Damien Morienus was a former master of the North Tower of the Host Tower of the Arcane in Luskan. Around 1269 DR, he relocated to Icewind Dale with his wife to finish research into achieving eternal life. Ironically, he achieved eternal life when he was cursed with undeath by becoming a crypt thing.

The Armor Piercing, Fin Stabilized, Discarding Sabot - Tracer (APFSDS-T) cartridge is a type of kinetic energy (KE) armor defeating round. It consists of a fin stabilized subprojectile, a tracer assembly attached to the rear of the fin and a depleted uranium (DU) or tungsten penetrator with a ballistic tip to reduce drag. It is currently recognized as the most effective tank-fired anti-armor round in the world.
Dammasae was an incantatrix of the Sorority of the Silver Fire and an opponent of the Cult of the Dragon in the early-to-mid 14 century DR. She was more famously the mother of Shandril Shessair.
Darkmaw the Wicked, also known as The Terror of Cloakwood, was a powerful and much-feared massive brown bear who lived on the Sword Coast sometime before the late 14 century DR.

A death knight was a mighty undead warrior created by gods of death or other malevolent forces. They were most commonly created from evil humanoids who in life had been blackguards, fighters, rangers, barbarians, and even paladins fallen from grace.

The 1st Tank Battalion is an armor battalion of the United States Marine Corps. It falls under the command of the 1st Marine Division and I Marine Expeditionary Force. The 1st Tank Battalion appears in Battlefield 3.
Dayan was a vampire necromancer in Undermountain in 1479 DR.

Dawn MacDare was a bloodforge mage in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars (648–657 DR). Dawn desired to take advantage of the Legendary Campaign leader's mission to unify and pacify the Utter East through conquest. Thus, Dawn made camp in the Web Mountains, from which they advanced on the Legendary Campaign forces. However, warned of the attack by the army's southern guard, the leader struck at Dawn's forces in a bloodforge battle.
Deathgaze was an ancient spirit naga in Myth Drannor during the late 14 century DR.
The 60mm High Explosive—Dual Purpose (HEDP) is an artillery shell capable of engaging infantry and armor.
Deathsleep was a green dragon who made his home in the Neverwinter Wood on the Sword Coast North in the late 15 century DR.

Deep Duerra (), or simply Duerra, was the duergar demigoddess of conquest, expansion, and psionics, and was venerated by those dwarves skilled in the mysterious Invisible Art. Ever the imperialist, the Axe Princess of Conquest was a resolute believer in the supremacy of psionics and the destiny of the duergar to rule all the Underdark.
Delina was a moon elf wild mage sorcerer who decided to travel to Baldur's Gate in order to find her twin brother, Deniak, whom she sensed was in trouble via their mystic bond.

The ACV-S (Armored Combat Vehicle - Stretched) is a further development of the M113, as it retains the basic shape of the particular vehicle. It was derived from the ACV-300, which was also based upon the M113. It is currently in service with Turkish Armed Forces. The ACV-S is a cut vehicle from both Bad Company games, intended to be an Anti-Aircraft Vehicle equipped with a VADS in the place of a gunner turret. It is based off of the M163 VADS variant of the M113, but uses the longer body of the Stretched variant.
Deep dragons, also called purple dragons, drakes of the depths, and silent hunters, were a type of chromatic dragon that lived in the Underdark.
Delethyrsos was a shadow dragon and the personal mount of Hadrhune in 1375 DR.

Deliah Deguerre was a commander and bloodforge mage in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars (648–657 DR). Deliah was a rival to the commander of the Legendary Campaign, who sought to unify and pacify the Utter East through conquest. The two became caught up in a protracted conflict. Their two armies raced to Edenvale Castle for reinforcement, but ended their rivalry before its walls.

The Armstrong Whitworth A.W.52 was a British experimental jet-powered flying wing aircraft, designed in the 1940s and making its maiden flight in 1945. Only 2 prototypes were ever built, with the first one crashing in an accident.
Delmair Rallyhorn was a half-elf ranger who loved to hunt evil monsters around 1358 DR. If struck by an enemy, he had the uncanny ability to temporarily transform into a tiger.
Derrnog was a warrior and ruler of hill giants in the Plain of Standing Stones in the 14 century DR.
Demeter () was a multispheric interloper goddess of fertility and agriculture from the Olympian pantheon. There was no evidence that this deity was directly worshiped in the Realms.

The Lockheed AC-130U Spooky Gunship is a heavily armed ground attack aircraft variant of the C-130 Hercules. The basic airframe is manufactured by Lockheed, while Boeing is responsible for the conversion into a gunship and for aircraft support. The AC-130 Gunship II superseded the AC-47 Spooky and AC-119 Shadow during the Vietnam War. __TOC__
Delphons, also known as songsharks, were an intelligent shark-like species of fish endemic to the River Oceanus that crooned powerful mind-affecting melodies.

Diirinka was the patron god of the derro (particularly the savants), and twin brother of their forgotten demigod Diinkarazan. Titled the Betrayer, Diirinka was a god of magic and knowledge, as well as cruelty, said to have created the derro by stealing magic and cleverly leaving his sibling to pay the price, teaching the degenerate dwarves the virtues of being deceitful and cruel.
Destrachans were evil, crafty, and sadistic aberrations that dwelled underground. They typically attacked with a powerful sonic blast emitted from their tubular mouths.

The Ordnance QF 25-pounder, or more simply 25-pounder or 25-pdr, was the major British field gun and howitzer during the Second World War, possessing a 3.45-inch (87.6 mm) calibre. It was introduced into service just before the war started, combining high-angle and direct-fire, relatively high rates of fire, and a reasonably lethal shell in a highly mobile piece. It remained the British Army's primary artillery field piece well into the 1960s, with smaller numbers serving in training units until the 1980s.
Dethud Tanthul was a shade necromancer and shadow adept and one of the twelve princes of Thultanthar in the 14 and 15 centuries DR.
Despayr was a black dragon that was unusual in a number of ways. He was born covered in glowing purple runes, could not breathe acid, and lacked the ability to cast spells like others of his kind.

Desert centaurs were nomads inhabiting the vast deserts of Zakhara. They often executed raids on bandit camps, using their speed and savage skills to their advantage. Desert centaurs were known to zealously protect their lands.

The APS Underwater Assault Rifle (Avtomat Podvodnyy Spetsialnyy (Автомат Подводный Специальный), Special Underwater Automatic Rifle) is an AK-47 derivative designed by the Soviet Union in the early 1970s as an underwater firearm. It was able to fire 5.66x39mm MPS underwater rounds. It was adopted in 1975. It is made by the Tula Arms Plant (Тульский Оружейный Завод, Tul'skiy Oruzheynyy Zavod) in Russia. It is exported by Rosoboronexport.
Dire whiners were rare demons that preyed on other creatures using magically enhanced insults.
Dhourn Ba'Tol was the third son of House Ba'Tol, a drow initiate of the Gravenhollow's Living Library, and a first-rank evoker who lived in the Underdark.
Dewez was a Netherese arcanist who oversaw the Mythallar Housing of Eileanar shortly before its destruction in .
The (Swedish: AutomatKarbin 5, English: Automatic Carbine 5) is the main service rifle of the . The weapon was originally based on the , and is manufactured by . It fires the standard cartridge.

Deucala was a werewolf from Moray in the Moonshae Isles during the mid-to-late 15 century DR. She was the matriarch of the lycanthropes of the Black Blood tribe along the northern coast of the island.
Dorina T'sarran was a drow vampire and a priestess of Kiaransalee in the late 14 century DR.
A displacer serpent was a magical beast, a snake-like being with a displacement-like ability.

The Galil ACE or IWI ACE is an Israeli assault rifle developed and manufactured by IWI and also produced under license by Indumil, RPC Fort and FAME S.A.C. The ACE family assault rifles are based upon the reliable mechanism of the famous Galil assault rifle. The ACE incorporates enhanced human engineering and ergonomics with the demands of the modern battlefield. The ACE 21 variant is the carbine variant, firing the 5.56x45mm NATO cartridge, its overall length is 730 mm (Stock Extended) with the barrel length being 215 mm. Much like the ACE 52 CQB it features a composite build, folding equipment and many accessory-rails.
Djinnlings, also called wind gen or air gen, were gen native to the Elemental Plane of Air.

Dogai, also known as assassin devils, were unseen killers and spies that stalked the Nine Hells under the cloak of shadows. Masters of espionage and the perfect instruments of political assassination, the baatezu hitmen silently dispatched the rivals of their diabolical masters and killed mortals that dared to defy evil.

A divine mind was a psionics wielding holy warrior, who channeled their control of the Invisible Art through faith and commitment to the ethics and values of their chosen god. As psionic paragons of their belief, these warriors were able to distill their passion towards a particular universal concept a god represented into a psionic mantle of thematic powers. They were akin to a paladin among the various types of psionics wielders.

The Galil ACE is an assault rifle developed by Israel Weapon Industries (IWI) and manufactured by IWI and also FAMAE and Indumil. The ACE family assault rifles are based upon the reliable mechanism of the famous Galil assault rifle. The ACE 23 is the primary Assault rifle variant of the family, chambering 5.56 x 45mm NATO like the ACE 22 and ACE 21, but sporting a barrel length of 460mm.

Merlin was a notorious scam artist and powerful mage that operated in the Vast region of north Faerûn in the 14 century DR. He traveled under a variety of different aliases, but was most well known by the pseudonym Discount Merlin.

The dracosphinx was a desert-dwelling hybrid creature related to red dragons, possibly created from a merging of a red dragon and an androsphinx. They were not truly related to sphinxes, being only named as such due to their body structure being so similar.
Draegan Guldar was a daywalker vampire and a low-ranking member of the Night Masters, the cabal of vampires who led the Night Masks.

The Galil ACE is an assault rifle developed by Israel Weapon Industries (IWI) and manufactured by IWI and also Indumil. The ACE family assault rifles are based upon the reliable mechanism of the famous Galil assault rifle. The ACE 53 variant is chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO like the ACE 52, but features the longest barrel length of the ACE family at 508mm. Like the rest of the ACE rifles, the ACE 53 features several attachment rails and an ergonomic design.
Dosal Marnath was a spectre within Hellgate Keep around 1370 DR.

Dorren was a ranger of the Yuirwood as of Mirtul 2, . He was so large a man that his fellow rangers often joked he was half giant. He was one of the rangers who participated in Kheil's torture on that night.
Draconnis was the nickname given to the blue dragon leader of a hill giant tribe from the Storm Horns of Cormyr in the 14 century DR.
The AK-12U is a proposed carbine variant of the Russian AK-12 assault rifle.
A dragon chicken was a strange creature that resembled an amalgam of a dragon and a chicken, both majestic and terrifying, while extremely prone to chaos.

Dragonborn of Bahamut (Ux Bahamuti in Draconic), also known as Platinum Knights, were a race of dragonkind created by the deity Bahamut during the Time of Dragons to act as his emissaries in the mortal realm. Unlike normal creatures, dragonborn of Bahamut weren't born naturally, but instead were creatures reborn from good-aligned non-draconic humanoids who, to show their devotion to Bahamut, willingly took on draconic traits in place of their original biology. Dragonborn of Bahamut were powerful creatures who resembled their adoptive father. They had strong determination and were natural leaders, who took on the responsibility to lead the battle against their aberrant antithesis, the spawn of Tiamat, as well as evil dragons in general.
The dragonheirs, formerly known as dragonmasters, were an Abeiran human bloodline who had been granted the power to control dragons by the primordials.

The Galil ACE is an assault rifle developed and manufactured by Israel Weapon Industries (IWI). The ACE family assault rifles are based upon the reliable mechanism of the famous Galil assault rifle. The ACE incorporates enhanced human engineering and ergonomics with the demands of the modern battlefield. The ACE 52 variant is the close-quarters variant of the ACE 51, being a lightweight carbine firing the 7.62x51mm NATO cartridge with a 400mm barrel and 935mm build with the stock extended. It features many high-tech additions, such as a composite build, multiple accessory-rails and folding equipment.

A dragon shaman was an uncommon type of primal mystic that recognized and respected true dragons as among the most powerful of mortal creatures, unsurpassed by few in their might and wits. Viewing them as awe-inspiring primal embodiments of the very principle of power, shamans sought to embody that primal power themselves by emulating dragons and choosing one of their species as a totem animal to follow.

Dread fangs, sometimes called dread fangs of Lolth are elite warriors of drow society, trained as rogues, typically in the service of a noble house or the Spider Queen. Cunning and deceptive, dread fangs embody the treacherous perils of drow society, though a few leave the terrors of their homeland for something better, becoming forces for good or at the very least opposed to Lolth's machinations. Masters of death, dread fangs excel at lowering their enemy's guard, and then, while they're defenseless, striking them down. They work together with the Eyes of Lolth.

Drakes were draconic creatures, distant and lesser cousins to true dragons. They were smaller and not as powerful as dragons but were much easier to train, so they were commonly used as mounts. They were often used as guards by dragons, or they were given to the dragons' humanoid servants.

The (Stealth Recon Scout) is a bolt-action sniper rifle developed by the American firearm manufacturer . It was unveiled at the 2008 SHOT Show. It is notable for being one of the few sniper rifles that has a bullpup bolt-action layout. This gives the rifle a relatively compact design; claimed to be 11 inches (280 mm) shorter than conventional sniper rifles. The SRS was originally designed around the cartridge, but is also available in other calibers. The SRS in .338 Lapua Magnum appears in three games in the Battlefield series, known as the 338-Recon in most appearances.
Drone Wyvernspur, called affectionately Uncle Drone by most of his younger kinfolk, was the archmage of Redstone Castle, the ancestral home of the Wyvernspur family.
Dretchroyaster (), or simply "Dretch", was an ancient green dracolich.

Dreads were undead creatures in the form of a pair of skeletal arms from small- to medium-sized humanoids. There was also a variation known as a vampiric dread that gained some health from the damage it inflicted.

The 120mm HE Shell (HE standing for 'High Explosive') are a type of ammunition used in tanks and other armored vehicles that favor explosive damage over armor penetration power. In modern weapons, HE Shells can be as small as 20mm and as large as 125mm.
Drelbs, otherwise known as Haunting Custodians, were a type of wraith-like creature that were native to the Negative Energy plane.
Dragonwights, also known as wight dragons, were a lesser undead form of dragon that were equivalent to wights.
Dron was a werewolf from the domain of Barovia, who lived during the Faerûnian 15 century DR.

The AMR-2 (Anti Materiel Rifle - 2) is a 12.7x108mm anti-materiel sniper rifle developed by China South Industries Group for the People's Liberation Army in the early 2000s. It was one of several designs evaluated by the PLA while searching for a modern anti-materiel rifle to supplement its forces, and is believed to currently be in use with Chinese Special Forces. The rifle is of conventional design with a manually operated rotary bolt and a free floating barrel with a very large double baffle muzzle brake to reduce recoil. The AMR-2 appears in as a Sniper Rifle Battle Pickup.

Dransagalor was a black dragon. An acquaintance of Sammaster, the two of them met, alongside Cylla Morieth, in Uktar 9 of the . Caught in the early stages of a Rage of Dragons, he attacked Sammaster together with Ormalagos; after he calmed their frenzy, Sammaster warned them a frenzy without end was coming and offered them the transformation into a dracolich. Though Needle was skeptical, Dransagalor had portents in his dreams that the frenzy would be truly without end, and was thusly resigned to his fate as a dracolich. He could cast the most elementary dismissal spell for most magical effects, likely dispel magic.

Durlag Trollkiller was the son of Bolhur the Clanless and one of the most powerful dwarves of his time, and undoubtedly one of the richest. As his name suggests, he earned his fame slaying trolls and other ferocious beasts, alongside a small band of adventurers. After retiring from adventuring, Durlag set about building a great tower in which to begin his own clan, to prevent him from dying alone as his father did.
Dune stalkers were evil monsters of earth, sometimes summoned to the Material Plane to hunt down a target and slay him or her with a "kiss of death".

The GAU-8/A Avenger is an American 30mm Gatling cannon produced by General Electric and is the primary armament of the A-10 Thunderbolt II. Using a combination of armor-piercing incendiary depleted uranium rounds and high-explosive incendiary rounds, the system is designed to defeat heavily armored vehicles. Similar weapon systems include the Russian Gryazev-Shipunov GSh-6-30.
Durlin was the last brewmaster of Myth Drannor who perished during the Weeping War and whose ghostly apparition could be seen and heard haunting the places he loved in life.
Dunnol was a duergar mind master that joined the cult of the Absolute during the late 15 century DR.
Eliette was a high elven woman who later became a phase spider matriarch that dwelled within the Whispering Depths caverns on the Sword Coast during the late 15 century DR.

A Hovercraft, also known as an Air-Cushion Vehicle or ACV, is a craft capable of traveling over land, water, mud or ice and other surfaces both at speed and when stationary. Hovercraft are hybrid vessels operated by a pilot as an aircraft rather than a captain as a marine vessel. Hovercraft use blowers to produce a large volume of air below the hull that is slightly above atmospheric pressure. The pressure difference between the higher pressure air below the hull and lower pressure ambient air above it produces lift, which causes the hull to float above the running surface. For stability reasons, the air is typically blown through slots or holes around the outside of a disk or oval shaped platform, giving most hovercraft a characteristic rounded-rectangle shape. Typically this cushion is contained within a flexible "skirt", which allows the vehicle to travel over small obstructions without damage.
Esmerella was a lycanthrope from Moray in the Moonshae Isles during the late 15 century DR.
The Eternal Wanderer was a murderous specter that haunted the High Road of Cormyr during the late 15 century DR.
An eye of flame was an unusually docile form of beholder. While still malevolent, eyes of flame were willing to serve beneath more powerful beholders.

The Metal Storm 3GL is a three-round semi-automatic 40mm grenade launcher. Like the M320, it can be used as a standalone weapon, or mounted on some Assault Rifles. Its higher capacity gives it an advantage over single-shot launchers, and is much smaller and lighter than traditional multiple grenade launchers such as the M32 MGL. It uses the superposed load system where multiple projectiles are loaded nose to tail in a single gun barrel with propellant packed in between.
Eziderax the Caustic was a black dragon who aided the Cult of the Dragon during the Siege of Neverwinter.

An eye of fear and flame, also known as a flameharrow, was a very rare type of undead, believed to be created by chaotic evil deities. This was said to be for the purpose of spreading darkness and destruction, as well as fomenting the downfall of lawful creatures. Though some claimed that they were also created by lawful gods to test their followers.
Eye mongers were large evil aberrations related to beholders that inhabited wildspace and preyed on creatures while masquerading as harmless asteroids.

The ARX160 is a modern assault rifle designed by Beretta in 2008. Created for the Italian military to replace its older AR 70/90 rifles, the ARX160 features a modular design with several ambidextrous features. The weapon is chambered for the standard 5.56x45mm NATO cartridge, although it can be easily converted to use other cartridges. The ARX160 was a Phase II contender for the US Army's Individual Carbine competition, and is currently in service with the Italian Armed Forces and a few special forces groups worldwide.
Eyewings were loathsome creatures inhabiting the Abyss on those planes where flying was possible.
Feena Archwood was a natural werewolf and cleric of Selûne. In 1373 DR she briefly served as Moonmistress of Moonshadow Hall and refounded the long-lost New Moon Pact.
A fang dragon, also known as a gray dragon, was a type of dragon found in Faerûn.

The , also known as the AWS, is an air-cooled, dual-feed light machine gun based on the platform that fires the cartridge. It has the ability to be fed from either a magazine or a belt, similar to earlier versions of the /M249 SAW. The Ares-16 AMG variant appeared in Battlefield 4 as AWS and FightLite MCR variant appeared in Battlefield 2042 as DFR Strife.

Fankolin Morninglight was a gnome living in the village of High Haspur in the Earthfast Mountains in the Vast. He was the patriarch of the ruling Morninglight family in 1367 DR and a practicing illusionist.
Fellandar was a once-human man magically transformed into a cat-like being, who sought the destruction of Waterdeep.
Feg was a trained and magically enhanced flying monkey that belonged to Kaverin Ebonhand of the Cult of Frost in the mid-14 century DR.

The AAC Integrally Suppressed Remington 700 is an American sniper rifle manufactured by Remington Arms. It is a modification of the R700 that has an integrally suppressed barrel. It appears in Battlefield Hardline as the .300 Knockout, where it fires the .300 Blackout round.
Felrivenser, also known as Gembright, was an amethyst dragon who dwelled in the Channel Lock within the empire of Netheril in the first to third millennia before Dalereckoning.
Fensir (), also commonly referred to by other creatures as Ysgardian trolls, were a race of giant-kin native to the plane of Ysgard that were distantly descended from true trolls.
Felevel the Green was the most powerful druid living in the vicinity of Olostin's Hold, northwest of the High Forest in the late 14 century DR.

The Galil ARM is a light-machine gun variant of the IMI Galil assault rifle chambered for 5.56x45mm NATO. Compared to the standard AR configuration, the weapon features a carrying handle and integrated bipod, as well as larger handguard. When folded up, the bipod functions as a speed chute during reloading. Originally, the handguards were made of wood, which would keep the barrel significantly cooler during sustained fire, but these were eventually replaced with polymer handguards. The Galil ARM appears in Battlefield Hardline as the ARM. In game, the weapon has both the bipod and carrying handle removed, and is categorized as an Assault Rifle.

Filfar "Trollkiller" Woodband was the lord of the town of Waymoot in Cormyr around 1372 DR. Filfar was discomforted by his nickname, having earned it after helping to rout a band of attacking trolls in his youth. He was very strong.
Fillistrom Wunderkundoodle was a healer in Phlan in 1489 DR.
Firefiex was a Dambraii horse that was the mount of Baron Montar Kaspar of the city of Kaspar in Ulgarth around 1367 DR. Firefiex was reputed to be the swiftest steed in the kingdom.

The Steyr AUG Para is a 9mm Submachine gun conversion of the AUG rifle. The weapon is intended primarily for Law Enforcement and special operations usage, offering a compact and relatively accurate weapon compared to other 9mm SMGs. Most of the AUG's basic components are retained in the conversion, with a short 9mm barrel, unlocked bolt, and magazine adapter components being installed on the base rifle. The A3 9mm XS variant is an updated version of the Para based on the AUG A3 platform.
A fire mephit was a mephit from the Elemental Plane of Fire.
Fionnghuala () was the demigoddess of swanmays and a member of the Outer Circle of Queen Titania's Seelie Court. The translation of her name was "white-shouldered".
Fey panthers were large, supernatural cats touched by the energies of the Feywild.

The Sturmpanzerwagen (Armoured Assault Vehicle) was a tank introduced by the German Empire in 1918, during World War I, in response to the British Empire's recent deployment of their Tank series. One hundred chassis were ordered in early 1917, ten to be finished as fighting vehicles with armored bodies, and the remainder as cargo carriers. However, the number of combat-capable vehicles rose to 20. Unlike many of its counterparts, each A7V was purely hand-made. They were used in action from March to October of that year, and were the only tanks produced by Germany in World War I to be used in combat.

A fey lingerer, sometimes known as simply a lingerer, was the undead remnant of a fey or eladrin that refused to die. They were animated by strong emotions, passions, or simply spite that their long lifespan had been cut short.
Fleabottom was a wererat and the leader of a cell of the Dead Rats gang in Neverwinter in the late 15 century DR.

Flinds were humanoid creatures related to gnolls. They were particularly strong and vicious gnolls that would command their war band. While flinds were admired and respected by their lesser cousins, there was no love in the end for the superior breed. If not found in a leadership role over other gnolls, flinds often wound up as solitary hunters.

The , also known by its nickname of the Vickers-Crayford Rocket Gun due to its distinct flaming muzzle flash, was a 40mm light artillery piece developed by the British near the end of World War I. The Vickers Q.F. Gun was intended to be used by infantry in the trenches to attack bunkers and machine gun nests, but saw little use due to the being cheaper and easier to use. The weapon was instead adapted for air-to-air use on attack craft to destroy Zeppelins and Observation Balloons, but the weapon was withdrawn from service entirely shortly before the end of the war due to misfire issues in combat. The Vickers Q.F. Gun Mk.II appears in Battlefield 1 as the AT Rocket Gun, depicted as an anti-tank infantry weapon available to all factions.

Firres () were a type of eladrin who were devoted to art and music. They were the most far-ranging of eladrin, often going to the Material Plane to seek out works of great beauty. They were counted among the greater eladrin and were famous for the eldritch beauty of their unmatched singing. Mortals could summon a firre to their aid with the most powerful of summoning spells.
Magus Firewand was a mage, scribe, and writer of Cormyr who authored the classic work of literature titled the Proceedings.
Flamedancer was a name used by a tshala that dwelt in the Flaming Brazier temple in Bezantur as of the mid-to-late 14 century DR and worked to undermine the Church of Kossuth from within.
The COW 37mm gun was an early large caliber aircraft weapon trialled by the British in WW1. It was tried unsuccessfully in several aircraft and in mountings on the ground.
Flo was a Thayan winged feline and oftentimes an adventuring companion of the stalwart defenders and heroes of Neverwinter during the turn of the 16 century DR.
Frostbite was a Cyricist winter wolf involved in the Zhent invasion of Shadowdale in 1375 DR.
Fourfinger was a Netherese arcanist that specialized in water- and weather-related magic.

The 57mm Cannon (5.7cm / 2 1/4 inches) dates back to at least the 1880s as a fortress gun, naval gun, and infantry field gun, often firing a 6-pound projectile. The QF (Quick Firing) 6-Pounder Hotchkiss was an early 57mm tank gun which armed most British tanks during World War I. The weapon was an adaptation of an earlier naval gun, made shorter for use on land. 57mm guns were also produced by Maxim-Nordenfelt for German tanks. The 57mm caliber is seeing renewed interest in Russian IFV designs such as the 2S38 cannon for the T-15 Armata IFV. Mark V IRL.png|A "Male" Mark V tank, with 6-Pounder gun sponsons. Private Ackrich is a U.S. Marine appearing in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS). Private Ackrich sports, like almost all other marines, an M16A4, however he tends to fire in long fully-automatic bursts.
The Brenner is a special enemy encountered in the Call of Duty: WWII Nazi Zombies mode. Brenners are large in size and are armed with a flamethrower which is their primary weapon.

The Deep Sea Lord is an enemy introduced in Call of Duty Online in the Ultra Zombies map Zombie Island. It appears at the end of the map, attacking the player by throwing rocks and water onto them. After sustaining enough damage, the Deep Sea Lord will escape, going back under the water.
The AA Rocket Gun is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1, introduced in the Apocalypse expansion. It is unlocked upon obtaining ten kills with the AA Rocket Gun.

King Draugvald the Undying is a unique Special Frost Zombie encountered in the Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Zombies map Totenreich. He does not spawn during standard gameplay and appears exclusively for the Super Easter Egg.

Mitzi is a character in V.E.R.S.I.O.N.. She is the younger sister of Bastien. Mitzi apparently possesses a very talkative personality. Mitzi is also recently augmented, apparently possessing enhanced cognitive abilities, as well as an improved liver and kidneys to increase her tolerance to alcohol. Because her mental augmentations seemed to link her up to the internet, she could find out information quickly just by thinking about it, causing Bastien to nickname her Mitzi-the-Wiki.

Shrieker Zombies, referred to as Sonic Zombies in the in-game files, are a variant of zombie appearing in the Zombies map Shangri-La. They have a whitish-blue glow to their appearance along with pale white skin, and blind the players temporarily by shrieking at them. They appear throughout the normal rounds as they do not have a dedicated round. They do not count as part of a round, so the round may change even if they are still alive. They spawn by blasting their way out of the ground with a sonic screech, so chances are the player will hear a Shrieker before seeing them. They also sprint constantly at a high rate of speed similar to that of the sprinting zombies in Verrückt, Call of the Dead, and Moon.

The AMX-10RC (RC stands for Roues-Canon, or wheeled gun) is a light reconnaissance vehicle built by GIAT. Initial work on the AMX-10RC began in 1970; production began in 1976, and the first production vehicle was delivered in 1981 to the 2nd Regiment de Hussards in Sourdun. The vehicle features a powerful GIAT 105 mm gun mounted in a welded aluminium turret. The turret also serves to house three crew members, while the driver sits in the front of the hull; the COTAC fire control system is provided for gun aiming. All six wheels are driven, and the AMX-10RC uses skid steering to turn the hull.
The Shadow Werewolf is an enhanced version of the Werewolf, and appears as the final boss of the Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 Zombies map, Dead of the Night.

Amelia is a Hero that is exclusive to Bloons Card Storm. She is a magician who is able to shield the bloons, reduce cost of power cards, and can forcefully make an opponent's monkey disappear. Amelia's voice actress is Vera Tan.

The Beekeeper is a Special Agent in Bloons TD 5, Bloons TD 5 Deluxe, and Bloons TD 5 Mobile which costs 120. It releases bees that stick to bloons and keep stinging bloons until all layers are gone. Bees attack Regrow Bloons quicker than normal, however, the stingers can't get through Lead Bloons or frozen bloons and damage MOAB-Class Bloons very little. The Beekeeper shoots bees at almost hypersonic speeds, and the bees can exit its range. Beekeeper makes a cameo in Beetienne's exclusive paid cosmetics. Beetienne likes to share honey with Beekeeper.

The Ordnance Quick-Firing 6-pounder 7 cwt, or just 6-pounder, was a British 57 mm gun, serving as a primary anti-tank gun of the British Army during World War II, as well as the main armament for a number of armoured fighting vehicles. Although planned before the start of the war, it did not reach service until the North African Campaign in April 1942. There, it replaced the 2-pounder in the anti-tank role, allowing the 25-pounder gun-howitzer to revert to its intended artillery role. The United States Army also adopted the 6-pounder as their primary anti-tank gun under the designation 57 mm Gun M1.

Magic Man is a non-playable character who appears in the game Bloons Adventure Time TD. He operates the entire Martian Games by hosting a new Martian Games event every two days, each with two to three different special rules added to the chosen map for extra challenge. He also makes appearance in the Martian Games as the kidnapper while the rule "Magic Man" is active. Every three rounds completed after completing Round 5, he will fly down to the map to kidnap a random tower (including interactable sub-towers such as Warrior Bubblegum's Candy Archers and Moe's MOs, excluding on-track towers such as Banana Guards) on screen and say "Magic! You're welcome" while kidnapping. The kidnapped tower cannot be rescued; it will effectively be sold for 0 cash. However, the kidnapped tower will become available to be placed again.

Rattleballs is a Super Rare Ally in Bloons Adventure Time TD that costs $880 to place. He rapidly attacks bloons with quick sword attacks. He attacks with the left hand and has three basic attack patterns: left/clockwise slashing, right/counterclockwise slashing, and charging.

Triệu Thị Trinh (8 November 226 – 4 April 248), better known by the honorific Bà Triệu or Lady Triệu, was a Vietnamese warrior who led an uprising against the Eastern Wu occupation of Vietnam, and afterwards became a popular and highly celebrated folk hero in Vietnamese culture. She leads the Vietnamese in Civilization VI. Bà Triệu uses her bonuses to unit speed and cheaper Thành districts for an effective defense as she acquires – or as a base from which to launch a Domination Victory.

The Sturmpistole, alternatively known as the Kampfpistole (German: Assault/Combat Pistol), was a handheld anti-tank grenade launcher developed by Nazi Germany during World War II. The weapon used Flare Gun components, modified with a shoulder stock and provision to use shaped-charge anti-tank grenades. The weapon did not see mass production, and its intended niche was filled mid war by the Panzerschreck and Panzerfaust series of launchers.
Acamas is a Maormer member of the Sea Vipers. He is one of the three mages taking part in the summoning of the storm that is to be used to destroy Mistral.

Adosi Serethi is a Dunmer ostler living in Aleswell. She is the sister of Diram Serethi, owner and innkeeper of the Aleswell inn. Like the rest of the citizens in Aleswell, Adosi was affected by an Invisibility spell that was placed on the town by Ancotar in the nearby Fort Caractacus. Adosi seems to be the most content of everybody in town about the whole mess, as now people do not bother her as much. Out of all of her siblings, she is the least friendly after the quest is completed, though this is caused by her brother.

Aela the Huntress is a Nord werewolf, thief, archer and member of The Companions. She is one of five members of The Circle. Residing in Jorrvaskr with the other Companions, Aela offers lycanthropy deep into the faction's questline. Additionally, she is an expert level Archery trainer, as well as a candidate for marriage and a follower after The Companions' main questline.

The Douglas A-20 Havoc was an American twin-engine multirole aircraft of World War II, entering service in 1941. Developed originally as a medium bomber and reconnaissance aircraft, variants would also be used as a night fighter and intruder under the USAAF designation P-70. 7,478 A-20s of various models were built, in addition to seeing use with the British, Soviet and Free French air forces.
Adric Beriel is a Breton ghost located in Crestshade, Rivenspire, in .

Ahzidal (Dragon Language: Ahzid–Al, "Bitter–Destroyer" or "Embittered Destroyer") is a dragon priest. According to legends, he was the first great Nord enchanter and, possibly, the first human to master elven methods of arcane magic. Along with Zahkriisos, Dukaan, Vahlok, and Miraak, he is one of the five such priests found on Solstheim.
Akar is a Nord werewolf and a member of the Frostmoon Pack. He can be found under Frostmoon Crag with the rest of the pack.

A 40mm Cannon fires 40mm projectiles, with the 40mm Bofors air defense cannon being the best-known example. The French EBRC Jaguar and British Ajax IFVs are equipped with a 40mm cannon as standard armament, with four types of cased telescoped ammunition available (and an additional two types for training). IRL Lynx KF41.jpg|WOTAN35 on the Lynx KF41, a 35mm weapon presented in Battlefield 2042 as a 40mm weapon. Jaguar IRL.jpg|CTAS40 on the EBRC Jaguar, a 40mm weapon presented in Battlefield 2042 as a 57mm weapon.
Air Atronachs are Daedra and a variant of Atronach that appear in Craglorn in . This creature is immune to Bleed Damage as of Update 4.

Akata is a Dremora residing inside a cave near the Shattered Grove. She is responsible for the corruption of the wildlife found in the woods nearby. They have a chance to drop Daedra Husks or Daedra Hearts.
Ahathka is Khajiit ghost part of Captain Bones' spiritual crew.

Alandro Sul or Alandro-Sul was a shield-companion of Indoril Nerevar during the War of the First Council. The supposed immortal son of Azura fought alongside Nerevar at the Second Battle of Red Mountain, and fought against the great Ysmir Wulfharth. During his conflict with Wulfharth, he was said to have lost his eyesight after getting struck by Ysmir's Thu'um. Wulfharth later died after being weakened by Dumac Dwarfking and slain by Indoril Nerevar. When the war was over, Alandro went to live with the Ashlanders of Vvardenfell, where he spread his belief that Nerevar had been murdered by the Tribunal. Alandro Sul was known to have his own armor which he wore during the battle against Wulfharth; the Wraith Mail, a chainmail headpiece that was made of a thousand ringlets.
the Merchant from .]] Alfiq are a furstock, a breed of Khajiit, extremely well-versed in magical arts and often used as spies.
Amragor is a Bosmer healer and the replacement of Laralthir. He will appear after completion of the questline. He lives together with Selene Duronia, inside the Chapel of Dibella in Anvil.

==Battlefield 2042== The 60mm Mortar Weapon Pod appears in as a specialization option for main battle tanks and IFVs. The pod gunner aboard heavy armored vehicles may fire a single 60mm mortar round, dealing significant damage to armored targets. The wide splash area is also dangerous to infantry. The high damage output is offset by the pod's long reload and difficulty of use at mid-long ranges. Though capable of high-arcing shots, there is no mortar aiming aid as in past titles (from Battlefield 3 onward).

Anglor's Ghost was a Bosmer conjurer who resided in the Shivering Isles in the ruined city Vitharn. His ghost can be found in the chapel preaching to a small number of the residents, when the Hero is searching for the Dagger of Depletion.
Anka-Ra Flame-Shaper is a Yokudan fire mage that uses special flame-shaping techniques, found exclusively in the Hel Ra Citadel Trial.

Aranea Ienith is a Dunmer priestess of Azura in who protects the Shrine of Azura outside of Winterhold. She wears blue mage robes and boots. Opening the Daedric quest, "The Black Star," Aranea becomes a possible follower if the Azura's Star artifact is selected over the Black Star. As a follower, she typically wields magic and prefers her own robes over items placed in her inventory. Aranea can also be inducted into the Blades.
The (Russian: Aвтомат Малогабаритный Avtomat Malogabaritnyj; English: Small-sized Automatic Rifle) is a carbine-length assault rifle developed and manufactured by . The weapon uses the cartridge.

Ansei Maja is a Redguard Ghost located in Tava's Blessing, Alik'r Desert, in . She is one of the Ansei who sacrificed themselves to create the Ansei Wards, so as to shield the Alik'r from necromancers.

Arden-Sul, also known as the Prophet, Dark Deceiver, and Artificer Superior, was a powerful prophet and the first Duke on the Shivering Isles. He was said to be "the greatest duke of the ages" and "a savior."

Arkved is an Altmer mage who is caught in an unexceptionable nightmare for stealing the Orb of Vaermina. He can be found in his tower south-southwest of Cheydinhal. He has left a handwritten note behind on the table in the room where he is found explaining what he did.

The XM913 is an experimental American chain gun developed by an American state-owned enterprise Picatinny Arsenal. The cannon is described to be very larger and more modernized from the 25mm Bushmaster cannon. The 50mm cannon isn't too much longer than the 25mm Bushmaster despite it having shells that are twice as wide (50 x 228mm) in diameter. Both the 50mm and 25mm cannons possess overall lengths of 105.2 inches and 117.7 inches, whereas the turret-intruding portions are measured 30.0 inches and 40.1 inches respectively.
Arie is a ghost found deep inside Windridge Cave in Stormhaven.
Arnbjorn is a Nord assassin and a member of the Dark Brotherhood, as well as a Werewolf. He is married to the leader of the Dark Brotherhood, Astrid.

Master Aryon is a Dunmer Sorcerer residing in his chambers in the stronghold of Tel Vos. He is a councilor of House Telvanni, and is the appointed overseer of Tel Vos. Levitate is needed to reach him. His mouth is Galos Mathendis. The guards describe Aryon as "half-Telvanni half-Imperial" like his city, which is a Telvanni mushroom growing out of a castle. Aryon is the most open-minded master of House Telvanni and, because of this, the conservatives disfavor him. He is searching for new allies, as seen in Message from Master Aryon. Aryon dislikes Archmagister Gothren because he is part of the conservative faction of House Telvanni, and will gladly suggest killing him in the Main Quest or during the final Telvanni quest.

The (Advanced Police Carbine) is a submachine gun produced by from . It can be used in , , (as the APC10) and cartridges. Taking feedback and experience from their another product, MP9, it was designed in 2000s and start produced in 2011.

Asgeir was one of the Five Hundred Companions of Ysgramor. He left Atmora at a very young age. Asgeir was a member of the Kaal Kaaz crew. In his childhood, he was the messenger of grim news: Ysgramor's final breath. It is said that he ran all over Tamriel to inform all the crews of the Five Hundred.
Arria is an Imperial ghost found deep inside the Cave of Broken Sails.

Ashamanu was a Dunmer Healer. Her corpse can be found in the Grazelands of Vvardenfell. Her body is part of the quest Dreams of a White Guar. She gave her own life to save the lives of others. It is said that she will give her life again and again, so that the Ashlander people may live through her sacrifice.

The 40mm Grenade is a Fragmentation or High Explosive weapon designed to be launched from a purpose-built grenade launcher, or an underslung attachment. It inflicts damage similar to a Hand Grenade, but is launched faster and further than a hand grenade can be thrown. It can be fatal to infantry, causes serious damage to light vehicles, but inflicts only minor damage to heavier armor. In all games where it appears (up to ), 40mm grenade launchers are assigned to the Assault kit.
Aspect of Strength is a bear aspect of Hircine found in the Fallen Grotto. It should be defeated to earn back Hircine's favor for the members of the Glenmoril Wyrd.
Baan Dar's Pyromancer is the generic name given to certain soldiers of Baan Dar, located at The Five Finger Dance.
Barnand Erelie is a Breton Healer living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. He is an apprentice member of the Mages Guild, and offers medium training in Mysticism, Restoration, and Alteration.

The AAV-7A1 AMTRAC, better known as the Amphibious Assault Vehicle, or LVTP-7, is a tracked armored personnel carrier used by the United States Marine Corps and it is built by US Combat Systems, a subset of BAE Systems Land & Armaments. "AMTRAC" is a contraction of "amphibious tractor." The AAV has been in service with the United States Marine Corps since 1972 and is used by ten nations worldwide since its introduction. The vehicle is capable of being launched from the sea by amphibious dock ships to bring assault elements quickly to the shore as well as provide combat support with a mounted Mk 19 grenade launcher or M242 Bushmaster cannon and the M2 Browning HMG. Despite its large size, the AAV-7A1 does not have heavy armor to withstand the firing of large caliber weapons. __TOC__
Bandit Thug is a type of bandit in . They are better-equipped than standard bandits and tend to wear heavy armor, making them tougher.
Balorgh is an Orsimer werewolf in located in the March of Sacrifices.

Belharza, also known as Belharza the Man-Bull, was the second Emperor of the Alessian Empire. He was the son of Alessia and Morihaus, and Morihaus was said to be a Demigod in the form of a winged bull. As a result, Belharza was sometimes referred to as a "man-bull" due to being a mix of Nede and Et'Ada Bull, thereby being the first Minotaur.

The (Russian: Автомат Специальный Вал, Special Automatic Rifle "Shaft"), is a Soviet-made assault rifle chambered for the cartridge with an integrated suppressor. Developed during the late 1980s by (Central Institute for Precision Building) it was later adopted in 1987 by the and and later the Spetsnaz, , , and parts of the Russian Ground Forces. Variants including the VSS Vintorez and are also produced.
Beldoh the Undying is a unique skeleton found in the Hall of Torque section of Vemynal, a Dwemer Ruin in the Red Mountain region. __NOTOC__

Beddi Alielle is the ghost of a Breton of the Mages Guild who can be found deep within Bewan, Auridon. She was killed by Sea Elves, and is cursed to remain as a ghost from an unfinished bet with Angrel.
Benirus Manor Ghost is an undead creature in . The ghosts can only be found in Benirus Manor during the duration of the quest Where Spirits Have Lease.

A 25mm Cannon is an autocannon firing 25mm shells for use against armored targets. Such a heavy weapon is typically mounted to vehicles. There are many motorized designs of 25mm cannon, from slower-firing chain guns to rotary cannons with very high rates of fire. Some designs continue to use blowback operation, powered only by the cartridges fired. Throughout the Battlefield series, many Infantry Fighting Vehicles use a 25mm chain gun as their main armament, with later entries offering a variety of ammunition types such as high explosive, armor piercing, and canister.

Berne Clan Brutes are generic Imperial vampire brutes residing in Galom Daeus, Vvardenfell, in . They are vampires, and a member of the Berne Clan. This enemy is always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no Disguises available to avoid combat.

Berne Frost Mages are generic Imperial vampire frost mages residing in Dushariran, Vvardenfell, in . They are vampires, and are part of the Berne Clan. This enemy is always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available Disguises available to avoid them.
Bjadmund is a Nord Battlemage who resides in Vivec City, Morrowind.

AK may refer to: *The Russian AK series of assault rifles and carbines: **AK-47 - An assault rifle featured in Battlefield Vietnam, Battlefield 2, Battlefield 2: Modern Combat, Battlefield: Bad Company 2: Vietnam and Battlefield Play4Free. **AKM - An assault rifle featured in Battlefield Vietnam and Battlefield Hardline. **AK-74 - An assault rifle featured in Battlefield Heroes, Battlefield 3 and Battlefield 3: Aftershock. **AKS-74U - A carbine featured in Battlefield 2, Battlefield 2: Modern Combat, Battlefield: Bad Company, Battlefield: Bad Company 2, Battlefield Play4Free, Battlefield 3 and Battlefield Hardline. **AK-101 - An assault rifle featured in Battlefield 2. **AK-12 - An assault rifle featured in Battlefield 4. **AKU-12 - A carbine featured in Battlefield 4. **AK-24 - An assault rifle featured in Battlefield 2042. *AK 5C - A carbine featured in Battlefield 4. *Battlefield 3: Armored Kill - An expansion pack of Battlefield 3, sometimes abbreviated as AK. *Armored Kill - A custom gamemode featured in Battlefield 1.

Blighted Kwama Warriors are Kwama Warriors that are infected with the Blight disease. They are a higher level version of the common Kwama Warrior. They can infect the Nerevarine with Ash-chancre, and inflict Shock Damage by casting Spark.

Blighted Nix-Hound is a creature in . They are blighted variations of the nix-hound. They are more powerful than the common Nix-Hound. They can inflict blight disease which Drains Endurance and Strength 20–40 points.
Boss Crito is an Imperial Battlemage in who resides in the Dwemer Ruins of Arkngthand.

The Escape Crew Capsule allows a pilot to escape from their craft while it is subjected to extreme conditions such as high speed or altitude. The crewman remains encapsulated and protected until such time as the external environment is suitable for direct exposure or the capsule reaches the ground. In the Battlefield series, the Assault Pod, alternatively known as a Drop Pod, Launch Pod, Landing Pod, or simply Pod was produced as a prototype by the newly formed Pan-Asian Coalition at a secret testing facility in the northwestern region of Russia. Based off the escape capsule of the B-58 Hustler, it first saw official use against the United States Marine Corps during the War of 2020 after the testing facility's location was uncovered by the US. Following the engagement, plans for the prototype Assault Pod were stolen by the USMC and both sides proceeded to further improve upon the design for practical military use. By the 22nd century it had seen full military deployment by the European Union and Pan-Asian Coalition during The Cold War.

Bralsa Andaren is a Dunmer who can be found near a Wayshrine of Kynareth that is northwest of Skingrad and Fort Dirich, west of Weatherleah and east of Nonungalo. She apparently resents nature and wildlife, as the Hero is required to kill bears and bring her 20 of their pelts in order to receive training. She often runs around the shrine with an invisibility spell hunting deer with Destruction magic. If met before asking her about training, she might get killed by the local wildlife. She will not return once the Hero have been directed to her for training. She can train from Journeyman level upwards.
Bremman Galenus is an Imperial fire-breather found at Hakoshae in Northern Elsweyr. He has no unique dialogue.

Brilnosu Llarys is a hostile Dunmer Battlemage and slaver residing in the stronghold of Hlormaren. She is the leader of the group of slave-smugglers here and can be found on roof of the keep. The Morag Tong have a writ of execution placed on her life.

Anti-Aircraft, in Battlefield 2, are, as the name suggests, units that are designed to defend against enemy aircraft, such as fighter jets and helicopters. There are two types of anti-aircraft exist in the game; a single, static AA site that cannot be moved, and a mobile AA vehicle designed specifically to take out aircraft.

Brodir Grove is a famous landmark in Solstheim. It borders the Isinfier Plains and the Hirstaang Forest. It is a basic small clearing with four pillars of stone, each said to a fabled Nord warrior betrayed by their companion. To the north of the Grove is the shack of Ulfgar the Unending. He was once a companion of the unfateful Nords, now cursed to be stones of the Brodir Grove; He ultimately slew the traitor, Grimkell, yet he was cursed himself. He is over 500 years old, and in his desire to find Sovngarde, he scoured the corners of empire and everything in between, but to no avail.
Brother Nidal is a Breton priest and healer who works at the Temple of Arkay.
Brimstone is a named flame atronach in . It is located at the Tormented Spire.

The Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress was a four-engine heavy bomber aircraft developed in the 1930s for the then-United States Army Air Corps (USAAC). From its introduction in 1938, the B-17 Flying Fortress evolved through numerous design advances.The B-17 was primarily employed by the United States Army Air Forces in the daylight precision strategic bombing campaign of World War II against German industrial and military targets. The B-17 also participated to a lesser extent in the War in the Pacific where it conducted raids against Japanese shipping and airfields. __TOC__

Bull Netch is a creature in . Bull netch are the males of the netch. They are greater in size than the female betty netch and sometimes have a poisonous attack. They have a tannish shell while having a purple skin under the shell. Bull netch also have six tentacles compared to the females that have only four. They also are greater in numbers than the betty netch.
Calix Thorntongue is a Draugr that was raised from the dead by the Worm Cult in Vernim Woods.
Captain Bones is a ghostly Khajiit sailor found at his wrecked ship east of the Forsaken Hamlet. He is accompanied by the rest of his crew and his ghostly monkey, Mr. Flint.

The Rockwell B-1B Lancer is a swept-wing strategic bomber aircraft operated by the United States Air Force and is built by Boeing Defense, Space & Security, the military division of Boeing. The B-1B Lancer has been in service since October 1986 and has seen use in Operation Desert Fox in 1998, the NATO intervention in Kosovo of 1999, and in both the wars in Afghanistan and Iraq since 2003. The B-1B fills the role of a long-range supersonic strategic bomber and it is the only variable swept-wing aircraft still in service with the USAF. __TOC__
Captain Cedus is an Imperial battlemage and captain of the Iron Hounds located at Iron Hound Camp, Vvardenfell, in .

The Canah is an exotic bird from the Summerset Isles. They are bred for their beauty, and their feathers can be found sold as gifts. A number of mysterious shrines to the goddess Kynareth doting the isle of Stros M'Kai allow those possessing such a feather to transform into one of these creatures as a means of transport.
Calefactors are Factotums that reside in the Reprocessing Yard of the Halls of Fabrication. They may be summoned by the Assembly General while in combat.

The Akrep (English: Scorpion) is a light armored mine-resistant vehicle produced by Otokar of Turkey. It is based upon the American Land Rover Defender chassis and was introduced in 1990 for the Turkish Army. The vehicle is much like a smaller cousin to the Cobra, also produced by Otokar. It is armed with 7.62mm or 12.7mm machine gun in a remote weapon station, although it can also use a ring-mounted system like on many other light reconnaissance vehicles. Due to the vehicle's V-shaped hull design, it is very resistant to roadside bombs and anti-tank mines, with the vehicle only being disabled by one rather than completely destroyed.

Carwen is a Bosmer acrobat living in Methredhel's House in the Waterfront District with Adanrel and Methredhel. She is a member of the Thieves Guild. As she is not used as a main quest character, she may be killed, and a bounty will be gained for killing an innocent.
Cartirinque is a ghost found just outside Eagle's Strand in the region of Khenarthi's Roost.

Captain Nym is an Ayleid ghost located in Glacier Crawl. In life, Nym captained an airship now embedded within a glacier. He gives the Soul of Conflict the Star Coif if they have collected all 7 Star Teeth.

An Auto Loader is a device that automatically reloads a normally non-automatic high-caliber firearm, e.g. a tank gun, or even a 406 mm naval "rifle" of a battleship. Autoloaders are used for either two reasons: to load shells too heavy to handle by a person, or to boost the rate of fire and cut down the number of the gun crew.
Captain Thoran is a powerful Nord warrior encountered as a boss in the Blessed Crucible.

Captain Wereshark is a fictional character appearing in a number of self-titled books in . These books include: *The Saga of Captain Wereshark, Part 1 *The Saga of Captain Wereshark, Part 2 *The Saga of Captain Wereshark, Part 3 *The Saga of Captain Wereshark, Part 4 *The Saga of Captain Wereshark, Part 5 *The Saga of Captain Wereshark, Part 6 *The Saga of Captain Wereshark, Part 7

Chanel is the Court of Chorrol's resident mage, and an excellent painter. She is an Apprentice Destruction Trainer, she is also one of the major suspects in "Canvas the Castle." After completion of the quest without having returned the painting, she will offer basic training in Destruction from noon to 8pm every day. She can also be found in her bedroom in the Private Quarters. She carries tan linens, a small amount of gold, a paint brush, a copy of the Castle Chorrol Private Area key, and the Countess' key. She wields no weapons, but instead she relies on a leveled set of Destruction spells. She had an illicit affair with the countess' husband, as revealed during the quest "Canvas the Castle." She will ask to keep the painting, as it belonged to the man she loved.

Alternate ammunition allows a firearm or weapon system to serve different purposes depending on its load. Depending on the game, alternate ammo may be provided either through specializations or as weapon accessories.

The Celestial Warrior is a being of immense power plummeted from the sky in . It leads an army of ancient Yokudan warriors in Lower Craglorn. The Celestial Warrior is encountered during the quests "The Time-Lost Warrior" and "Assaulting the Citadel."
Cectyda is a Maormer member of the Sea Vipers. She is one of the three mages taking part in the summoning of the storm planned to be used to destroy Mistral.
Caula Sestius is an Imperial residing in Suran. She can be found breathing fire near the waterfront in Suran. She is located south of Neleth's Trading Post.

The Antonov An-22 Antei (NATO reporting name "Cock") was the world's heaviest aircraft, until the advent of the American C-5 Galaxy and later the Soviet An-124 and An-225. Powered by four pairs of contra-rotating turboprops, the design remains the world's largest turboprop-powered aircraft. It first appeared outside the Soviet Union at the 1965 Paris Air Show.
